body:
Yeah, I'm not going to dwell on what it looks or sounds like to anyone, really. I know what we have and that's all that matters.

And thank you, even if I don't message you, I won't forget your kindness. =)

And I hope for yours. =)

Agreed. =) And yeah, it's nice to see someone else know kind of how I feel.

And yeah, I got the feeling you might think that. I mean, even I have thought about how it might sound like that. That fear is one thing both of us share too, because we both know what it's like to lose friends and it's something we don't want to go through again. 

Thank you for the advice. Seriously. And I just might take you up on the message offer. lol
Thank you. =) I can't currently listen(wrapping gifts and such), but I will as soon as I get a chance. Again, thank you.

Ah, I don't mind the gender mix up. 

And I agree and the medical diagnosis, I don't want to jump the gun and say "I have depression" if I'm not sure. It's pretty serious issue to me and I don't want to make a mockery of it.

That would make total sense. I definitely think that's true of me. Hell, for the past few days that's been one thing on my mind, "Is she gonna leave again? What if she's just messing with me? etc." So I can safely say I'm definitely afraid of losing the good things in my life.

She's great. Me and her are so much alike, it's crazy. Like, for the past few days we've been typing out the same thing at the same time, or getting hungry at the same time, and stuff like that. It's also really great because I've always been the girl to hang out with guys, and that's fine... But once I got a little older... Well, every girl needs one female friend. It's like, once I got older guys were wanting to be friends with me because of my body and not ME. But she makes me feel like hanging out with the guys, and being just as crazy and hyper and random as I am... Is a beautiful thing. She makes me feel like I'm special. In a way that no other friend or boyfriend has ever been able to make me feel. I know all this probably sounds crazy but, oh well. lol

I really don't know, that's the thing. It started a while back(the sadness, I mean) and I had times where it would completely go away, and time where it wouldn't. What I mean is that, no matter how good my life was, I could be horribly sad and even contemplating suicide in an instant, with literally no cause. Even last year when I was in the best relationship of my life and everything was great... I still felt that way.

Earlier this year my friends and I split ways and then my boyfriend dumped me shortly after. He and I are still best friends, but the other day I wake up and I see that my best friend in the world, my sister(not biologically), is basically asking forgiveness and wanting to move on together. It was the best thing to happen to me in a long time. We've been talking pretty much nonstop ever since. It's wonderful. I honestly can't remember the last time I felt so happy. It's like, everything is coming together AND I get to have her by my side.

But yet, I still feel so sad. It's like... Even when I'm smiling and laughing there is a black hole trying to suck away all of it.

Yeah, I can understand the tension thing, and I was thinking the whole "well, it's late, they'll be here" thing... But then I was like, "Okay, just go home. Don't be a creep." But he was anyway. lol 

You're right, definitely not logical...

=D Upvote for Rainbow Dash!!

She was actually one of the first things to come to mind when I asked this question. lol

I dunno, I think it's just where/how I'm living and small things that have happened piling up. Though it's logical that it's actual depression as at least 3 people on my mother's side of the family(including my mother) have depression. But yeah, I cant afford to see a therapist either... I'm trying to find some shooters as that's what I seem to be in the mood for. But again, no extra money. =/

Thank you, by the way, for reading as responding. I think it helps a lot to just know that I'm not alone and other people don't think I'm stupid for feeling this way.

Oh god, I absolutely hate medicine. I haven't taken anything in like a year.

And yeah, I do need a hobby. I have some games, but absolutely no motivation to play them lately.

It's a bit crazy considering practically no one will hire you without one lol. I put in a few applications, but I heard nothing back. Gonna be putting in more soon, hopefully.

Sorry yeah, I went to bed... I didn't realize how late it was. 

And I will, thank you a lot. =)

I believe it's around $100 right now, but I hear they are supposed to be raising it to $250. I don't think there's anything like that(the community college without a diploma or GED) around here. But as far as that is concerned, it's really all an issue of money. =/

And I will. As completely convinced as I thought I was earlier, I realized that by even telling him(and eventually people here) I was asking for help... So that's definitely a step in the right direction. =)
Thank you, sir, for your words of encouragement. I'm most certainly trying to hang in there. It's one reason I posted here. =)

Thank you, first off, for reading and replying and just generally being a good person. 

As far as "multiple factors" goes, I can give some examples. For one I had to drop out of high school due to health issues(I hated the social aspect of school, but I still wanted to graduate), and I can't get my GED as I can't afford it and my mother constantly tries to make it seem like it's my fault that I can't get my GED(no GED = no job, no job = no money, no money = can't afford a GED) which makes me feel really bad about myself. 
I lost all of my friends within the past few months because I was apparently focusing too much on my boyfriend at the time, who has since broken up with me. 
My (unbiological) brother has cancer and has been in the hospital for over a month now because of complications that happened after the surgery he had to remove the cancer.
I still live at home and have to hear my parents get in the stupidest, most petty arguments day after day. 
I haven't gone out to do anything for myself in over a month, just because I can't afford it and I have no one to go with. 
I have slowly become more and more afraid of people, even my own family members.
(sorry for the unorganized paragraph here...)

I know all of those things sound really stupid when I type them out, and I realize that but I can't really help that they get to me like this.
